description.value: Annora Restaurant is a fine West Coast dining destination in Langley City, founded in November 2016 by chef-owner Aaron Turkstra, a Dubrulle culinary school honours graduate with executive chef experience across multiple Vancouver-area restaurants. The kitchen focuses on top-quality, locally sourced British Columbian ingredients with everything prepared in-house, producing dishes that reviewers describe as among the best in the Fraser Valley. The restaurant also accommodates private events for up to 30 guests and offers a BYO wine option alongside its curated BC wine list.
